lines.t: How did you manage to finish the report so early?
How long does the orientation usually take?
Who's leading the workshop this afternoon?
Listen to a talk in an economics class.

Let's look at microfinance. Microfinance means providing very small loans to people who can't get credit from regular banks. Usually these borrowers are small business owners in rural areas—someone who wants to buy a sewing machine or a few goats. Instead of asking for property as a guarantee, many lenders ask borrowers to form groups of five. If one person can't pay, the others in the group help out, so members encourage each other to repay on time.
Critics point out that interest rates can be high, because it's expensive for lenders to manage thousands of tiny loans. Still, repayment rates are often surprisingly strong.

ctest.text: Geologists study how natural {{}} shape mountains over millions of years.

items.explain: how + 형용사(natural) + ___ + 동사(shape) → 동사의 주어 = 복수 명사. formed(분사)가 아니라 forces

ctest.text: Careful {{}} of tree rings can reveal droughts that happened centuries ago.

items.explain: 형용사(Careful) 뒤 + 조동사 can 앞 → 주어 명사. examined / examining이 아니라 examination

ctest.text: Often {{}} as the lungs of the planet, rainforests absorb huge amounts of carbon dioxide.

items.explain: 문장 머리 + 콤마 뒤 주어(rainforests) → 분사구문. 숲은 '묘사되는' 쪽 → p.p. described

items.explain: be + ___ + to V → 형용사 보어. difficult to read
